versions.content: The function FrIf_ControllerInit shall wrap the FlexRay Driver API function Fr_ControllerInit() by: 1. Translating (based on static FrIf module configuration) the FlexRay CC index Fr If_CtrlIdx into a tuple (FlexRay Driver | Driver-specific CC index Fr_CtrlIdx). 2. Calling Fr_ControllerInit() of the determined FlexRay Driver module with the pa- rameters determined as described above.
